summary: First full E2E test of UKM Permadu Darmajaya. Backend: 34 pytest cases (health, auth/JWT, seed counts, filters, dashboard/summary aggregation, RBAC for all 6 roles, CRUD+persistence for programs/finances/documents/agenda/users) - all 34 PASSED (100%). Frontend: Playwright runs across ketua, bendahara, sekretaris, kabid.kerohanian and anggota - login (quick-login + manual), invalid-login error, route guard, role-based sidebar, dashboard stats/charts/agenda, program bidang filter + ketua approve, keuangan tabs + create/delete transaksi, sekretariat 4 tabs + create/delete dokumen, agenda create + month grouping, anggota directory + role filters, logout and mobile menu - all functional flows PASSED. Additional exploratory API probing found RBAC scoping and validation gaps (see backend_issues). All TEST_ data created was cleaned up; seed counts restored (12 users / 9 programs / 9 finances / 7 documents / 6 agenda).

critical.issue: Kabid RBAC is not scoped to their own bidang. Verified: kabid.kerohanian successfully PATCHed (200) and DELETEd (200, deleted=1) a 'Seni & Budaya' program created by kabid.seni, and successfully created a program for bidang 'Humas & Media'. Frontend only hides other bidang via client-side filter, so this is exploitable via API. Enforce user['bidang'] == program['bidang'] for kabid on create/update/delete.

status is an unvalidated raw `str` query param. Verified: status=NONSENSE returned 200 and was persisted, corrupting the status enum used by dashboard aggregation (program_by_status). Use Literal/Enum validation matching ProgramCreate.status.

minor.issue: Deleting a non-existent id returns 200 {'deleted': 0} instead of 404; clients cannot distinguish success from no-op (frontend still toasts 'Dihapus').
Create endpoints return 200 instead of 201 Created.
Any authenticated role (incl. anggota) receives full directory with email, phone, nim of all 12 users. Acceptable for a directory feature but consider trimming PII for role=anggota.
UserUpdate.role is a free-form Optional[str] (not Literal), so an invalid role string can be persisted; also bidang is not validated against BIDANGS anywhere.
Uses deprecated @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown'); migrate to FastAPI lifespan handlers.

issues: Date fields use the native browser date input (<Input type="date">) rather than the shadcn Calendar/Popover date picker used elsewhere in the design system - inconsistent look across browsers

After saving a new transaction the active tab filter (e.g. 'keluar') is kept, so a newly created 'masuk' transaction is invisible even though the toast says saved. Consider resetting the tab to 'semua' or switching to the created type after save.
No client-side validation: a program can be saved with empty description/dates/budget=0 (produced a card showing 'Rp 0' and '- -> -'). Mark required fields and disable Simpan until valid.
Destructive deletes use window.confirm() instead of the shadcn AlertDialog - inconsistent with the rest of the polished UI.

action_items: Scope kabid permissions to their own bidang for POST/PATCH/DELETE /api/programs (currently cross-bidang write is possible).
Validate the `status` query param of POST /api/programs/{id}/status with the same Literal enum as ProgramCreate (NONSENSE was accepted and stored).
Return 404 from DELETE endpoints when nothing was deleted, and 201 from create endpoints.
Constrain UserUpdate.role to the Literal role set and validate bidang against BIDANGS.
Fix react/no-unstable-nested-components lint errors in AnggotaPage.jsx (Section/UserCard defined inside render).
Optional UX: reset Keuangan tab filter after creating a transaction; add required-field validation in create dialogs; replace window.confirm with AlertDialog; use shadcn date picker.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py create_program/update_program/delete_program rely only on require_roles('ketua','wakil','kabid') - add an ownership check `if user['role']=='kabid' and payload.bidang != user['bidang']: raise HTTPException(403)` and the same for the target document on PATCH/DELETE.
set_program_status signature `status: str` bypasses Pydantic validation because it is a bare query param - use `status: Literal[...]` or an Enum.
Delete handlers silently succeed on missing ids (`return {'deleted': r.deleted_count}`) - raise 404 when deleted_count == 0.
AnggotaPage.jsx defines <Section> and <UserCard> components inside the render body (eslint react/no-unstable-nested-components), remounting the whole subtree on every state change (filter clicks).
server.py is 564 lines and holds models + auth + all routers + seed data; consider splitting into routers/, models/, seed.py before it grows past 700 lines.

success_rate.backend: 100% (34/34 pytest cases; RBAC scoping gaps found via exploratory probing, not counted as endpoint failures)

seed_data_creation: No permanent seed data added. Temporary TEST_ records (program, finance, document, agenda, user) were created and deleted; verified zero TEST_ leftovers and seed counts back to 12/9/9/7/6. Program 'Bakti Sosial Desa Rama Utama' was approved then reverted to 'diusulkan'.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite is at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (34 cases, run: pytest backend/tests/backend_test.py). Frontend data-testids: login-*, quick-login-<role-slug> (e.g. quick-login-kabid-kerohanian; quick-login only fills email, password is prefilled), sidebar-link-{home|anggota|program|keuangan|sekretariat|agenda}, logout-btn, mobile-menu-btn, stat-{anggota|program|saldo|doc}, program-card-<id>, add/save-program-btn, program-filter-{all|<bidang>} (added by me), user-card-<id>, anggota-filter-{all|<role>} (added by me), finance-tab-{semua|masuk|keluar} (added by me), add/save-finance-btn, finance-amount-input, tab-{surat_masuk|surat_keluar|notulen|arsip}, add/save-document-btn, doc-title-input, add/save-agenda-btn, agenda-title-input. NOTE: Login page auto-redirects to / when a token exists, so always logout (logout-btn) before switching roles in Playwright. Deletes use window.confirm - register page.on('dialog', accept). Not yet retested: wakil role UI, user create/edit via Anggota UI dialog, program Edit dialog for kabid.
rca_of_the_issue: RBAC gap RCA: require_roles() only checks the role string and never compares user['bidang'] with the target program's bidang, so any kabid token can write to any bidang's programs; the UI hides them only via a client-side filter in ProgramPage.load(). Status corruption RCA: set_program_status declares `status: str`, which FastAPI treats as an unconstrained query parameter, so Pydantic never validates it against the 6 allowed values and the raw string is written straight into Mongo via $set, later feeding dashboard program_by_status buckets.
